purpose: Test whether a document-isolated development-calibrated threshold on a per-case robust same-span consensus score can abstain on missing evidence without the absolute-logit failure observed in v50, then confirm once on a previously unopened split.
source_access_order: Freeze this protocol, implementation, runner and synthetic tests and register their SHA-256 values without opening dev or train content.
Open only dev.json, form the frozen balanced development sample, build a label-free blind cache, generate deterministic queries and score every candidate before joining dev labels.
Perform the registered document-group five-fold out-of-fold threshold calibration and evaluate the frozen development gate.
If any development gate fails, publish DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT_NOT_ESTABLISHED and stop without opening train.json.
If every development gate passes, freeze the final all-dev threshold, development artifacts, implementation and CUDA environment in a confirmation-opening registration.
Only then open train.json, form the frozen balanced confirmation sample, build and score a separate blind cache, join train labels once, publish every outcome and forbid reuse.

source_schema_erratum_inherited_from_v50.rule: Skip only official spans whose exact half-open text slice is whitespace-only, preserve every retained span's original span_NNNN index, and fail before queries if any gold evidence id is absent.

development_scope.sampling: Within each label, frozen SHA-256 order over label, document id and hypothesis key; advance labels in lockstep under the shared six-per-document cap; fail before scoring unless exactly 80 per label can be formed.
development_scope.fold_assignment: First 16 hex digits of SHA-256(fold salt plus document id), interpreted as an integer modulo five.

confirmation_scope.split: official train used once as untouched confirmation
confirmation_scope.sampling: Within each label, frozen SHA-256 order over label, document id and hypothesis key; advance labels in lockstep under the shared six-per-document cap; fail before scoring unless exactly 200 per label can be formed.

blind_candidate_and_query_contract.candidate_pool: Every retained non-whitespace official span in the full given contract, with original canonical span_NNNN id.

query_templates.first_fact: Find contract language that directly entails or supports the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.second_fact_or_bridge: Find contract language that contradicts, negates, or rules out the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.counterevidence: Find exceptions, exclusions, limitations, or scope conditions relevant to the following statement: {hypothesis}

robust_consensus_score.case_score: maximum per_candidate_consensus over all retained spans
robust_consensus_score.gate: pass if and only if case_score is greater than or equal to the frozen dev threshold

development_threshold_selection.threshold_candidates: The next representable float below the minimum development case score, every midpoint between adjacent unique finite development scores, and the next representable float above the maximum score.
fit_order: Keep only thresholds satisfying every feasibility constraint on the fit documents.
Maximize evidence_or_abstention_macro_f1 across the three budgets.
Then choose the numerically lower threshold.
development_threshold_selection.no_feasible_threshold: Fail closed and do not open confirmation train.
development_threshold_selection.oof_procedure: For each of five document folds, fit the threshold on the other four folds by the frozen rule and evaluate it once on the held-out fold; concatenate held-out predictions for the development gate.
development_threshold_selection.final_threshold: After OOF evaluation, fit once on all 240 dev cases by the identical rule; freeze its exact float hexadecimal representation before train is opened.

confirmation_methods.official_span_nli_bert: Paper reference only; no compatible released trained weight is claimed, simulated or included as an executable baseline.

confirmation_evaluation.per_case_metric: Evidence-set F1 for Entailment or Contradiction; exact empty-selection accuracy for NotMentioned.

known_scope_limits: The dev threshold is supervised development and cannot itself prove generalization.
Using the official train split as untouched confirmation is an explicit experimental role reversal, not an official ContractNLI leaderboard result.
This is full-given-contract span selection and missing-evidence abstention, not open-corpus retrieval or end-to-end NLI classification.
A positive result would support only the frozen robust guard under this split protocol; it would not reproduce Span NLI BERT, SetR or a flood-domain expert evaluation.
